findings.issue: No Sentry or external error tracking integration found — errors not captured outside console/pino
findings.impact: Silent errors in production cannot be aggregated, alerted on, or traced without external monitoring
findings.fix: Add Sentry.init in app.ts before routes mount; add captureException to all catch blocks in middleware

findings.issue: No Prometheus metrics endpoint or gauge export visible — metrics only used internally via recordWebhookDelivery
findings.impact: Operators cannot monitor request rates, error rates, or latency without external APM
findings.fix: Add prometheus client counter/histogram exports and expose /metrics endpoint behind auth middleware

findings.issue: Worker has no Prometheus metrics — no visibility into job processing rates, failures, or queue depth
findings.impact: Worker failures or queue backlogs invisible until user impact occurs
findings.fix: Add prom-client to worker, track job completion/failure metrics per processor

findings.issue: Logger wraps pino but has no serialization config for errors (err property) or request context
findings.impact: Error objects logged as generic strings, losing stack traces and structured metadata
findings.fix: Add pino serializers for err, req, res objects to ensure structured error logging

findings.issue: Worker Dockerfile has no HEALTHCHECK directive
findings.impact: Docker/docker-compose cannot detect worker process health; compose healthcheck depends on outside endpoint
findings.fix: Add HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=5s --retries=3 CMD wget --no-verbose --tries=1 --spider http://localhost:4100/healthz || exit 1

findings.issue: No incident response runbook found in docs directory
findings.impact: Operators lack documented procedures for diagnosing and responding to common failure modes
findings.fix: Create docs/runbooks/incident-response.md with escalation paths, health check procedures, and recovery steps

findings.issue: Audit log failure queue uses in-memory array — lost on process restart; no Redis persistence
findings.impact: Pending audit log entries are lost if the API process restarts during queue backpressure
findings.fix: Replace in-memory audit queue with Redis-backed queue (BullMQ) or at minimum a DB-backed retry table
